newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Profit propels Woodside shares higher.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Profit propels Woodside shares higher.

text.p: Shares in North-West Shelf operator Woodside Petroleum Ltd surged 22 cents to an intraday high of A$8.88 on Wednesday, the rise fuelled by a well-received full year profit result.
The oil and gas major reported a 58 percent higher net profit of A$190.96 million for calendar 1996.
"Woodside has kicked up considerably since their result came out," said a dealer at a Melbourne brokerage.
By 1.00 p.m. (020 GMT), Woodside shares were 18 cents higher at A$8.84 on turnover of 521,592 shares.
Woodside is 40 percent owned by the Royal Dutch/Shell Group.
